changes.note: The ShopifyAPI::Base class has been removed. Global configuration is now handled via ShopifyAPI::Context.setup.
Removal of support for 3rd party cookies; introduction of session tokens and authenticatedFetch for authentication.
Deprecated the dependency of graphql-client gem. No longer need to dump schema to a local JSON file.
Existing query and response parsing must be refactored to use new GraphQL HTTP Client classes.
The use of ActiveResource has been deprecated. REST API requests must now use auto-generated, version-specific resources.

changes.before:
order = Order.find<id>
order.fulfillment_status = "fulfilled"
order.note = "Fulfilled on September 6, 2023"
order.save
changes.after:
order = Order.find(id: <id>)
order.fulfillment_status = "fulfilled"
order.note = "Fulfilled on September 6, 2023"
order.save!
changes.note: Updates to resources now use bang methods for persistence.
Deletion has moved from an instance method to a class method.
Helper methods for resource connections that are not direct properties in the REST API (like transactions on Order) are no longer supported.
